text: ちきゅうを　やく１６じかんで　１しゅう　してしまう。

structure.en: it goes all the way around once

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing gets done completely, here with a sense of amazement at how fast. １しゅう　してしまう = 'it goes all the way around'.

patterns.name: 〜で (amount used)
patterns.explanation: で after a length of time tells how much time it takes to get the thing done. １６じかんで = 'in 16 hours'.
